description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, triggering Bloodghast, Golgari Rot Farm, and Kodama.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Bloodghast enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodghast, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Kodama's trigger, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, triggering Bloodghast and Golgari Rot Farm.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 5.
